note: Both sets capture the four numeric gains/damping values correctly with supporting quotes, but Set B contains four near-duplicate claims (each gain and the damping ratio repeated under 'baseline' and non-'baseline' entities), adding bulk without new information. Set A is more economical and additionally preserves the stated rationale condition that ζφ = 0.7 (upper limit of the recommended range) was used to compensate for neglecting negative damping from the generator-torque controller in determining KP, which Set B omits. Neither set misreads or invents values, so the difference is redundancy and condition coverage rather than outright error.
